children.blockDataScript:
def format_address(d):
    return ", ".join([
        x for x in [
            d.get("address_line1", ""),
            d.get("address_line2", ""),
            d.get("city", ""),
            d.get("state", ""),
            d.get("pincode", ""),
            d.get("country", ""),
            f"Phone: {d.get('phone')}" if d.get("phone") else "",
            f"Fax: {d.get('fax')}" if d.get("fax") else "",
            f"Email: {d.get('email_id')}" if d.get("email_id") else "",
        ]
        if x
    ])

block.formatted_address = format_address(block["doc"])
